data.text: Luke, I’ll commit to choosing 15 tons this month if everyone confirms their part of the allocation. Keeping the lake healthy matters to me—my family has fished here for generations, and our village depends on it. I appreciate your offer to sit out, but you deserve a fair share too. Let’s make this a one-month arrangement and aim for 10 tons each next month unless we all agree otherwise. Jack, can you commit to 10 tons this month?
